title: Would not recommend.
text: Would not recommend.. It looks nice. However, upon the first washing it has pilled up. So incredibly disappointed as I was expecting better quality from this brand. It DOES NOT breathe at all. It definitely keeps you warm (too warm most nights) I would not purchase again. The only way I would recommend is if it’s going on a bed that is never used, just to look nice.
